name: license-info
description: Open a LICENSE file and LuminaIDE tells you which license it is and, in plain language, what it allows. Covers MIT, MIT-0, ISC, 0BSD, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, Zlib, BSL-1.0, Unlicense, CC0-1.0, WTFPL, MPL-2.0, EPL-2.0, LGPL-2.1, LGPL-3.0, GPL-2.0, GPL-3.0, AGPL-3.0, OFL-1.1, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0.
